tips.text: Farm Requiem Obelisks instead of fishing and mining; Heciphron, Pustulent Cognitive Nodule, Bapholite and Adramalium all come out of them.
Kill obelisk-affected enemies with your Operator or a Necramech; Warframe kills give nothing.
Run the obelisks inside an Isolation Vault; enemies keep spawning there, while a surface obelisk sits on a 10-minute cooldown.
Skip building a better Amp; a Necramech or Xaku's Whisper covers the Operator kills.
Bring a pull or grouping ability such as Khora's Ensnare so more enemies stand inside each obelisk activation.
Fish Barbisteo for Dendrite Blastoma; each fish gives exactly one, whatever its size.
Hunt Cryptosuctus for Pustulent Cognitive Nodule on a Fass cycle; it never spawns during Vome.
Claim a finished blueprint from the Foundry before sacrificing it; never hand over one that is still building.
Rank up to Stranger before shopping; the Purified Heciphron blueprint at Otak needs Rank 1, so one trip at Rank 0 is not enough.
Cash in only enough tokens for the rank-up; Rank 0 holds at most 5,000 standing and the rest is wasted.
Reach Mastery Rank 11 before spending standing; below it you can own every part and still not equip the weapon.
Expect two play sessions across two days, mostly waiting on the 24 hours of Foundry time.
Players call reaching Entrati Rank 1 one of the least annoying syndicate grinds, since you can stockpile its currency without loss.
